description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Alistar''' tramples the ground around him every 0.5 seconds over 5 seconds, becoming [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosted]] and dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. Each time this damages at least one enemy champion, he generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Trample'' that lasts for the remaining duration, stacking up to 5 times.
description.text: Active: Alistar tramples the ground around him every 0.5 seconds over 5 seconds, becoming ghosted and dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. Each time this damages at least one enemy champion, he generates a stack of Trample that lasts for the remaining duration, stacking up to 5 times.

description2.raw: At 5 stacks, '''Alistar's''' next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] against a [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] within 6 seconds ends ''Trample's'' effects to deal 20 – 275 (based on level) '''bonus''' magic damage and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] the target for 1 second.
description2.text: At 5 stacks, Alistar's next basic attack on-hit against a champion within 6 seconds ends Trample's effects to deal 20 – 275 (based on level) bonus magic damage and stun the target for 1 second.

notes.raw: * ''Trample'' deals [[File:Poison Trail.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent area damage]] [[:Damage|persistent area damage]] damage around '''Alistar''', while the bonus damage on the resulting attack is [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc damage]]. * The [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] and '''bonus''' damage are blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shields]] but the base attack damage is not. * The on-hit effect is consumed if the attack [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]], but not if it is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] or missed while '''Alistar''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. In all cases, the attack's effects are negated as normal. * The bonus damage and stun can be applied by [[File:Guinsoo's Rageblade item.png|20xpx|border|link=Guinsoo's Rageblade|An icon for the item Guinsoo's Rageblade]] [[Guinsoo's Rageblade|Guinsoo's Rageblade's]] Phantom Hit if the triggering attack did not. ** If the triggering attack does however apply the bonus damage and stun already, then Phantom Hit cannot apply them a subsequent time by triggering on-hit effects, despite ''Trample's'' empowered attack being an on-hit effect.
notes.text:
Trample deals persistent area damage damage around Alistar, while the bonus damage on the resulting attack is proc damage.
The stun and bonus damage are blocked by spell shields but the base attack damage is not.
The on-hit effect is consumed if the attack blocked, but not if it is dodged or missed while Alistar is blinded. In all cases, the attack's effects are negated as normal.
The bonus damage and stun can be applied by Guinsoo's Rageblade's Phantom Hit if the triggering attack did not.
* If the triggering attack does however apply the bonus damage and stun already, then Phantom Hit cannot apply them a subsequent time by triggering on-hit effects, despite Trample's empowered attack being an on-hit effect.
